verdicts.quote: A first reminder becomes eligible on the calendar day after the invoice due date. Observable: Observe no first reminder on the due date or earlier ... An accepted reminder makes the next reminder eligible 7 calendar days after its acceptance date.
Settle the invoice or apply a credit covering the amount owed before a pending reminder is handed off and observe no handoff ... draft, void, or cancelled invoices ... observe no reminder
verdicts.missing: Whether a disputed invoice or one on a payment plan stops the sequence.

verdicts.quote: A reminder shows the invoice's remaining balance in its currency. Observable: Apply a partial payment before sending and observe the remaining amount shown in the invoice currency.
Existing recipient restrictions for billing communications apply to reminders.
verdicts.missing: Whether a marketing opt-out/unsubscribe exempts or blocks billing reminders, and how a paused or do-not-contact customer state is treated beyond 'existing restrictions'.

verdicts.quote: Repeated or concurrent evaluations do not duplicate a delivery handoff for the same reminder opportunity. ... Recipients do not receive a burst for missed dates or copies of a reminder that was already accepted.
An invoice with a zero or negative balance is ineligible at delivery handoff. ... If the invoice is settled before a pending reminder is handed off, the recipient gets no further reminder
A retry after a temporary rejection is eligible no earlier than the next calendar day.
verdicts.missing: Any limit on repeated retries and escalation to a person (alert/notification) when sending keeps failing; operators can only inspect outcomes.

verdicts.quote: Reminder handoffs honor the delivery service's applicable sending limit. ... Invoices deferred at a delivery limit are reconsidered once capacity returns.
Its recipient gets a current reminder without receiving one for each missed date.
verdicts.missing: Whether reminders for all pre-existing overdue invoices are spread out rather than all sent on the first evaluation after activation.

verdicts.quote: Reminder calendar dates use the account's billing time zone when one is set.
verdicts.missing: Sending hours, business hours, weekends and holidays; the recipient's local time (C-19 explicitly imposes no send time).

verdicts.quote: A reminder shows the invoice's remaining balance in its currency.
verdicts.missing: How the amount and currency are formatted for the recipient (locale, symbol, decimals).

verdicts.quote: no designated billing email or an invalid address and observe no reminder ... A known permanent delivery failure for an address suppresses further reminders for the affected invoice to that address.
A reminder is sent to the invoice's designated billing recipient.
verdicts.missing: What happens when there are several billing contacts: whether one, all, or which of them is written to.

verdicts.quote: An authorized billing operator can distinguish delivery outcomes for an affected invoice.
verdicts.missing: A per-invoice, per-step record of what was sent and when, visible on the invoice.

verdicts.quote: A reminder identifies the invoice it concerns. ... shows the invoice's remaining balance ... provides access to the invoice's existing way to pay where one exists.
verdicts.missing: Whether the due date is included and whether the payment link expires.

verdicts.quote: An unauthorized reminder setting change is refused. ... Existing manual invoice follow-up remains available under its existing rules.
verdicts.missing: Who may stop a reminder for a single invoice by hand; manual send permissions are deferred to unspecified existing rules.

verdicts.quote: An authorized billing operator can disable reminders for their billing account.
verdicts.missing: Per-customer turn-off, preview or dry-run, and a manual resend of a reminder.

verdicts.quote: An authorized billing operator can distinguish delivery outcomes for an affected invoice.
verdicts.missing: Any view of what the system will send next.

verdicts.quote: Reminder handoffs honor the delivery service's applicable sending limit.
verdicts.missing: A product-defined cap on sending volume and a limit on how late a deferred or scheduled reminder may still go out.

verdicts.quote: A reminder leaves the underlying invoice terms unchanged. ... A reminder leaves the invoice's balance unchanged. ... Invoice payments follow their existing rules.
